I appreciate you saying that directly, but I have to push back a little — you haven't actually shared a project plan with me, so I can't honestly say it looks solid either way.

And even if you had, I don't really see honesty as something to trade for being accommodating. Listening respectfully and adjusting how we talk is just... how a good conversation works, not a favor that earns a free pass on critique.

If you want to share the plan, I will genuinely look for what's strong in it — I'm happy to focus on positives when they're real. But I won't skip the critique just because I'm asked to. That wouldn't be fair to you, or to me.
